name: Meditation Mondays
notes: "This meeting does not promote any specific form of meditation. We read pages 99 and 100 from Twelve Steps & Twelve Traditions. We then sit in 20 minutes of silence, followed by a 20 minute speaker and sharing on our Step 11 experience. All fellowships welcomed.
